lines.en: label mollyspring2:
scene clearnightsky
I’ve spent so much time indoors today that I didn’t realize how dark it had already gotten.
lines.zh: 今天在室内待了太久，我都没注意到天已经这么黑了。

lines.en: You’d think that after going so long without sunlight just a short while ago that my biological clock may have somewhat recalibrated to compensate for that, but no.
lines.zh: 你大概会以为，前不久刚熬过那么长一段不见天日的日子，我的生物钟多少该重新校准过来补偿一下了。可没有。

lines.en: As it turns out, even the most intangible parts of your body must be exercised in order to properly function.
lines.zh: 事实证明，就连身体里最摸不着的那些部分，也得经常用才能正常运转。

lines.en: Which is perhaps why I might feel so numb right now as the organ that’s meant to be pounding was buried roughly six feet beneath the surface before I ever met this girl.
lines.zh: 也许这就是为什么我现在感觉这么麻木——那颗本该怦怦跳的器官，早在遇见这个女孩之前就被埋在了大约六英尺深的地下。

lines.en: But it’s because of that absent muscle that I’m able to do things like this in the first place.
lines.zh: 可也正因为我少了那块肌肉，我才能做出现在这种事。

lines.en: And now that the mass inside of my skull no longer has the motivation to act in the place of a heart, I find turning her away to be nothing more than a waste of time.
lines.zh: 如今我颅腔里那团东西再没有动力去代替心脏行事，我便觉得，把她拒之门外不过是浪费时间。

lines.en: I’m sure that satisfies a less fragile existence inside of my head. But you know that things are bad when the only reason I’d say no right now is to get revenge on it.
lines.zh: 我敢说，这下我脑子里那个没那么脆弱的存在该满意了。可要是我现在唯一的拒绝理由只是想报复它，那情况有多糟也就可想而知了。

lines.en: It’s quiet — as nights like this typically are. But there’s a certain level of excitement to it as well.
lines.zh: 很安静——这样的夜晚通常都是如此。但也带着某种兴奋。

lines.en: We both know where we’re headed. We know what’s going to happen when we get there. So all there is to feel in the dark is...anticipation. Maybe even worry on {i}her{/i} end.
lines.zh: 我们都知道要去哪儿，也都知道到了那儿会发生什么。所以在这黑暗里，唯一能感受到的就只有……期待。也许在{i}她{/i}那边还有几分不安。

lines.en: The nerves are plentiful, that much is for sure. But for her, their sole function is to try and dissuade her from wasting what little purity she’s maintained on a man twice her age.
lines.zh: 紧张感确实很足，这点毫无疑问。但对她来说，那些紧张唯一的用处，就是劝她别把仅剩的那点纯洁浪费在一个年纪是她两倍的男人身上。

lines.en: And for me, all they’re doing is making my hands shake.
lines.zh: 而对我来说，它们唯一的作用就是让我的手发抖。

lines.en: That’s what pockets are for, though. So my hands make their home inside of them as I open my mouth to cut the tension before stitching it back together and making it even stronger.
lines.zh: 不过口袋就是用来干这个的。于是我把手安顿在口袋里，同时开口想打破这份紧张——结果只是把它缝了回去，缝得更紧。

lines.en: : I don’t really want anyone else to see me at the dorms, Molly.
lines.zh: : 我其实不太想让别人在宿舍看到我，Molly。

lines.en: : ‘Tis fine, Sir. I’ll use Cloak of Shadows.
lines.zh: : 无妨，先生。我会用「暗影斗篷」的。

lines.en: : I’m serious. Why don’t we just go somewhere else? Like a love hotel or something?
lines.zh: : 我是认真的。我们干嘛不去别的地方？比如情人酒店之类的？

lines.en: : That...might be a little much. Wouldn’t it? I’ll feel more comfortable surrounded by my figures, Sir.
lines.zh: : 那……可能有点过了吧？被我的手办包围着，我会更自在，先生。

lines.en: : But will you feel more comfortable with the looming threat of others listening in?
lines.zh: : 可一想到随时可能有人在旁边偷听，你还能自在吗？

lines.en: : Ah, about that. Touka recently took it upon herself to fund the soundproofing of my room as my constant screaming was impacting her sleep, Sir.
lines.zh: : 啊，关于这个。Touka 最近主动出资给我房间做了隔音，因为我老是尖叫影响她睡觉，先生。

lines.en: : It’s good knowing that all it takes to get your way is continuously bothering people.
lines.zh: : 真好，原来只要一直烦人就能达到目的。

lines.en: : Aye. It is clearly an effective method if you’re still with me right now, Sir.
lines.zh: : 是。既然您现在还跟我在一起，这方法显然是有效的，先生。

lines.en: : Does it really have to be the dorms, though?
lines.zh: : 可真的非得是宿舍吗？

lines.en: : A special quest reward awaits you there, Sir. And it’s one that’s mandatory for progression as well. We don’t want your development being halted, do we?
lines.zh: : 那里有一份特殊任务奖励等着您，先生。而且是推进剧情的必经奖励。我们可不想您的成长被卡住，对吧？

lines.en: : Molly-
lines.zh: : Molly——

lines.en: scene black
: I’ll check the halls ahead of time to make sure there’s no one there, Sir. It’ll be like you never came at all.
lines.zh: : 我会提前去走廊确认没有人在，先生。到时就跟您根本没来过一样。

lines.en: : In the...sense of your actual location, I mean. I do hope that, in the other way-
lines.zh: : 我是说……在您实际位置这个意义上。我希望在另一种意义上——

lines.en: : Save it for when we’re in your room, Molly.
lines.zh: : 留到进你房间再说吧，Molly。

lines.en: scene dorm2
It isn’t long before we’re there and I come face to face with a familiar sight...but I can’t help but feel like something’s changed.
lines.zh: 没过多久我们就到了，迎面而来的是一幅熟悉的景象……可我总觉得有什么东西变了。

lines.en: I practically used to live here with how frequently I visited the girls. And more often than not, the purpose was far from pure. So at least {i}that{/i} much hasn’t changed.
lines.zh: 我以前往这里跑得那么勤，几乎等于住在这儿了。而且大多数时候，目的都远远谈不上纯洁。所以至少{i}这一点{/i}没变。

lines.en: The atmosphere, though...
lines.zh: 可氛围……

lines.en: It’s like something’s missing.
lines.zh: 好像少了点什么。

lines.en: scene black
: {i}Quietly, Sir. Our stealth mission is nearly complete.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}小声点，先生。我们的潜行任务就快完成了。{/i}

lines.en: Oh, right.
lines.zh: 哦，对了。

lines.en: What’s missing is {i}her.{/i}
lines.zh: 少掉的是{i}她{/i}。

lines.en: scene mollysuckubus1
Even on another floor, I can feel her absence.
lines.zh: 就算在另一层楼，我也能感觉到她的缺席。

lines.en: And I’m not saying that her existence as a whole is what gave me comfort when I used to enter this building-
lines.zh: 我不是说，过去我走进这栋楼时，是她整个人给了我安慰——

lines.en: I’m just saying it would comfort me now.
lines.zh: 我只是说，现在它本该能安慰我。

lines.en: But I suppose this is the part where I do what I’ve always done and replace that comfort with something that’ll feel mostly the same so long as I close my eyes.
lines.zh: 不过我想，现在又到了我一贯的做法登场的时候：用另一种只要闭上眼睛就感觉差不多的东西，去替代那份安慰。

lines.en: Because even if she’s not here, her friends are. And if I lose myself in them, maybe she’ll shatter the fabric of reality just to show up and belittle me for being an unfaithful deviant.
lines.zh: 因为就算她不在，她的朋友们还在。如果我沉溺在她们身上，也许她会撕碎现实的结构专门跑来出现，就为了贬低我这个不忠的变态。

lines.en: I think I’d like that.
lines.zh: 我觉得我会喜欢那样。

lines.en: Then, the two of them could go down on me together.
lines.zh: 然后，她们俩就可以一起给我口交了。

lines.en: : So...here we are.
lines.zh: : 那么……我们到了。

lines.en: : I came back to the dorm with Rin after my “date” with her as well.
lines.zh: : 我跟 Rin “约会”结束以后，也是一起回了宿舍。

lines.en: scene mollysuckubus2
: Again with the bloody bragging. There’s no escape...
lines.zh: : 又来了，该死的炫耀。真是躲不掉……

lines.en: : Just trying to draw more parallels. And besides, there’s nothing to even brag about since her intentions were never sexual and yours are.
lines.zh: : 只是想多找点共同点。再说了，根本没什么好炫耀的——她的意图从来都跟性无关，而你的有。

lines.en: scene mollysuckubus3
: Should they not be, Sir? I wouldn’t want to force you into {i}another{/i} situation you’re uncomfortable with after the misunderstanding in the dressing room.
lines.zh: : 难道不该有吗，先生？在试衣间那次误会之后，我可不想{i}再{/i}把您逼进一个您不舒服的处境。

lines.en: : Does it even matter? I’m the one who gave you these ideas in the first place, aren’t I?
lines.zh: : 这还重要吗？最先给你这些念头的不是我吗？

lines.en: : If you are referring to the idea of sexually experimenting with a handsome older man, surely not. I believe that is something we all imagine at least once.
lines.zh: : 如果您说的是跟一个英俊的年长男性做性方面的尝试，那当然不是。我相信这种事我们每个人都至少幻想过一次。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : Weekly.
lines.zh: : 每周一次。

lines.en: scene mollysuckubus4
: But we probably never would have gotten to this point if I hadn’t told you all that time ago that I’d be open to “experimenting” with you.
lines.zh: : 不过要不是我很久以前就说过我愿意跟你“尝试”，我们大概也走不到今天这一步。

lines.en: : ‘Tis easy to say that in hindsight, Sir. But we don’t know that for sure. The type of girl I am and the type of man {i}you{/i} are could have easily landed us in this very same event.
lines.zh: : 事后说这种话当然容易，先生。可我们并不能确定。我是这样的女孩，{i}您{/i}是这样的男人，光凭这两点，我们也完全可能落到同一个事件里。

lines.en: : And if you’d like my opinion, Sir, the troubles and turmoils we’ve endured on the way here make it all the more exciting. So it is my belief that this meeting is somewhat fated.
lines.zh: : 而且如果您想听我的意见，先生，我们一路走来经历的种种波折让这一切更加刺激。所以我相信，这次相会多少有点命中注定。

lines.en: : You believe in fate?
lines.zh: : 您相信命运？

lines.en: : I believe in {i}fae{/i}, Sir. And the idea of {i}fate{/i} is far less fantastical than that.
lines.zh: : 我相信{i}精灵{/i}，先生。相比之下，{i}命运{/i}这个概念可没那么奇幻。

lines.en: scene mollysuckubus5
: Which isn’t to say I’m not nervous at all...I certainly am.
lines.zh: : 但这并不是说我一点都不紧张……我当然紧张。

lines.en: : I’ve never done anything like this outside of games, but...
lines.zh: : 游戏之外，我还从没做过这种事，不过……

lines.en: : But I have...ways in which I can attempt to counteract those nerves, Sir...
lines.zh: : 不过我有……办法试着抵消那些紧张，先生……

lines.en: : Like?
lines.zh: : 比如？

lines.en: scene mollysuckubus6
: I believe the best way of informing you would be to have you close your eyes for a minute or two, Sir.
lines.zh: : 我想，最好的告知办法，是请您闭上眼睛一两分钟，先生。

lines.en: : When they open again, {i}then{/i} you will know exactly what I’m referring to.
lines.zh: : 等您再睁开时，{i}就{/i}会明白我指的是什么了。

lines.en: scene black
: Okay. But if you’re planning on using this time to kill me, please make it as slow and painful as possible.
lines.zh: : 好。不过如果你打算趁这段时间杀了我，请尽量弄得又慢又痛。

lines.en: : D...Don’t people typically ask for the opposite?
lines.zh: : 人、人们通常不是应该求相反的吗？

lines.en: : Not anyone who actually wants to die. Or I guess “deserves” is a better way of putting it.
lines.zh: : 真正想死的人不会。或者用“活该”来形容更贴切。

lines.en: : You’ve done naught to deserve death, Sir. ‘Tis the law of the land that disallows the actions we’re about to take with one another. And even then, they’d not be punishable by-
lines.zh: : 您没做过任何该死的事，先生。不许我们做接下来这件事的，是这片土地的法律。而且就算如此，那也不至于判——

lines.en: : As much as I appreciate you attempting to justify this on my behalf, I ask that you keep your mouth closed.
lines.zh: : 我很感谢你替我开脱，但请你闭上嘴。

lines.en: : Entirely? But that would make what I’m about to attempt nigh impossible, Sir.
lines.zh: : 完全闭上？那我接下来要做的事就几乎不可能完成了，先生。

lines.en: : Very funny.
lines.zh: : 真好笑。

lines.en: : Sir, all I am saying is that if I had any belief that this was wrong, I wouldn’t be doing it. You may now open your eyes.
lines.zh: : 先生，我只是想说，如果我真觉得这有什么不对，我就不会做了。您现在可以睁开眼睛了。

lines.en: scene mollysuckubus7
: And I’m saying that-
lines.zh: : 而我想说的是——

lines.en: : I forget what I was saying.
lines.zh: : 我忘了我要说什么了。

lines.en: : I cast Charm on you while your eyes were closed, Sir.
lines.zh: : 我在您闭眼的时候对您施了魅惑术，先生。

lines.en: : What {i}is{/i} that?
lines.zh: : 那{i}是{/i}什么？

lines.en: : My aforementioned confidence booster, Sir. You see before you Yrelixis, Succubus of the Void — experienced satiator of ten thousand lusts.
lines.zh: : 就是我之前说的自信增强剂，先生。站在您面前的是 Yrelixis，虚空魅魔——满足过一万种欲望的老手。

lines.en: : I see a redhead with wings and not nearly enough clothing.
lines.zh: : 我看到的只是个长着翅膀、衣服少得可怜的红发姑娘。

lines.en: : Same difference, Sir.
lines.zh: : 差不多啦，先生。

lines.en: : You put that on really quickly.
lines.zh: : 你换装换得真快。

lines.en: scene mollysuckubus8
: Mortal — did I or did I not inform thee that mine prior cloth was easy to shed?
lines.zh: : 凡人——我有没有告诉过你，我先前那身衣服很容易脱？

lines.en: : You’ve informed me of many things and the vast majority have gone over my head, but I can promise you that that one didn’t.
lines.zh: : 你告诉过我很多事，绝大多数我都左耳进右耳出，但我可以向你保证，那一句没有。

lines.en: : Then why dost thou remain upright when thou should be begging for...thou’s life?
lines.zh: : 那你为何还站着？你本该跪下来求……求你那条命？

lines.en: : So I {i}am{/i} going to be killed.
lines.zh: : 所以我{i}是要{/i}被杀的。

lines.en: scene mollysuckubus9
: Behave and I shall spare thee the smallest bit of energy while consuming {i}everything else.{/i}
lines.zh: : 乖乖听话，我就给你留一丁点能量，{i}其余的统统吸干{/i}。

lines.en: : This is certainly going to be an interesting {i}first{/i} sexual escapade.
lines.zh: : 这{i}初次{/i}性体验肯定会很有意思。

lines.en: scene mollysuckubus10
: The cosplay isn’t too much, is it? Because this is more for me than it is for you, but I have others that may also accomplish the same feat if you find the wings too distracting or-
lines.zh: : 这身 cos 会不会太过了？因为这更多是为了我自己而不是您——不过如果您觉得翅膀太碍眼，我还有别的角色也能达到同样效果，或者——

lines.en: : Oh, it’s fine. But I hope you know that this sets a precedent for future events and that I’m going to want to see what other {i}characters{/i} you have in store.
lines.zh: : 哦，没问题。不过我希望你明白，这给以后开了个先例——我会想看看你还留了什么别的{i}角色{/i}。

lines.en: scene mollysuckubus11
: That may just be the single most alluring sentence I have ever heard.
lines.zh: : 这大概是我听过最诱人的一句话了。

lines.en: scene mollysuckubus12
: Now, down with thee!
lines.zh: : 现在，给我趴下！

lines.en: Molly catches me off guard and manages to push me to the ground after I lose my balance.
lines.zh: Molly 趁我不备，在我失去平衡的瞬间把我推倒在地。

lines.en: : From this moment forth, thou ist under the command of Yrlexis and shall do as I bid! Is that understood, mortal?
lines.zh: : 从这一刻起，你归 Yrlexis 支配，一切听我号令！明白了吗，凡人？

lines.en: : Do I really have to roleplay as well?
lines.zh: : 我也非得角色扮演吗？

lines.en: : OOC: I suppose not, Sir. But please keep questions to a minimum so I may stay in character from this point onward.
lines.zh: : OOC：我想不用，先生。不过请您尽量少提问，这样我接下来才能保持在角色里。

lines.en: : Also, please provide verbal consent so as to prevent any more misunderstandings.
lines.zh: : 另外，请给出明确的口头同意，以免再发生什么误会。

lines.en: : Consent given.
lines.zh: : 同意。

lines.en: scene mollysuckubus13
: As if your consent means anything to Yrlexis!
lines.zh: : 你的同意对 Yrlexis 来说算得了什么！

lines.en: scene black
: Now, mortal — do as I command and removest thine trousers or I will banish them to the void!
lines.zh: : 现在，凡人——照我的命令脱下你的裤子，否则我就把它放逐到虚空里去！

lines.en: : Yes, Yrlexis.
lines.zh: : 遵命，Yrlexis。

lines.en: I do as Molly asks and play along, unzipping my pants and revealing myself to her.
lines.zh: 我照 Molly 说的配合她，拉开裤子拉链，在她面前露了出来。

lines.en: And it doesn’t take long until she joins me on the ground.
lines.zh: 没过多久，她也跟着我坐到了地上。

lines.en: scene mollysuckubus14
She crawls closer, forcing me back until I’m pressed against the door as she positions herself between my legs.
lines.zh: 她爬近过来，把我逼得往后退，直到后背抵在门上，而她在我两腿之间占了位置。

lines.en: : Such a long and powerful member...I expected nothing less from you, mortal.
lines.zh: : 好长、好威武的一根……我就知道您不会让我失望，凡人。

lines.en: : I’m sure it’s positively brimming with power...
lines.zh: : 我敢说它一定正满溢着力量……

lines.en: scene mollysuckubus15
: I can feel the heat radiating from your core as you fall deeper under my spell...
lines.zh: : 我能感觉到您核心散发出的热意，而您正越陷越深地落入我的法术……

lines.en: : You shall think of no one but I — the one who binds thine heart with chains of lust that can be broken by no one else.
lines.zh: : 除了我，您不许再想任何人——就是用那谁也斩不断的情欲之链，把您的心拴住的我。

lines.en: : You shall be my toy for the rest of eternity...do I make myself clear?
lines.zh: : 您将永远做我的玩具……我说明白了吗？

lines.en: scene mollysuckubus16
: And what an excellent toy you shall be, mortal...
lines.zh: : 而您会是个多么出色的玩具啊，凡人……

lines.en: : I can already feel your energy coursing through my body...there is no greater feeling known to man...
lines.zh: : 我已经能感觉到您的能量在我体内奔流……世间没有比这更美妙的感受了……

lines.en: : Tell me...do you feel it as well?
lines.zh: : 告诉我……您也感觉到了吗？

lines.en: Molly gently strokes the head of my cock, lubricating it with the precum that’s already seeped from it as I continue to “fall under her spell.”
lines.zh: Molly 轻轻抚弄着我的龟头，用它已经渗出的前列腺液做润滑，而我继续“坠入她的法术”。

lines.en: Her hand can barely fit around me, but that doesn’t dissuade her from carefully and gently exploring it, pumping softly and managing to make me even harder.
lines.zh: 她一只手几乎握不过来，但这并不妨碍她小心翼翼、轻柔地探索着它，缓缓套弄，把我弄得更硬了。

lines.en: It’s like I’m being studied. She can’t take her eyes off of it. But I guess that’s what happens when you let a degenerate like her close to real dick for the {s}first{/i} second time ever.
lines.zh: 感觉我像是被研究的对象。她一刻也移不开眼睛。不过我想，让一个像她这样的死变态有生以来{s}第一次{/s}——呃，第二次——近距离接触真家伙，结果就是这样吧。

lines.en: : Truly spectacular...I believe it’s even longer than the tentacle.
lines.zh: : 真是壮观……我觉得它比那根触手还长。

lines.en: : Tentacle?
lines.zh: : 触手？

lines.en: : Aye...but less thick around the base.
lines.zh: : 是……不过根部没那么粗。

lines.en: : I can’t tell if you’re insulting me or not.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你这是在损我还是夸我。

lines.en: scene mollysuckubus17
: Of course not, mortal. Yours is truly the most magnificent of all...
